$comment: The tab map: which tabs of the authorized workbook the Sheets importer may
read, and what each one is. A tab's editorial stage is never inferred from
its name or shape; it is declared here, and changing it is a reviewed commit.
Only a tab whose stage is rss_source_corpus is intake. The weekly candidate
tabs are calibration data for classification and are deliberately absent.
This file holds no identifier and no digest of one. Tab titles are the
owner's names for parts of the workbook and are already printed by the
inventory. firstDataRow and columns are one-based counts; timestampColumns
are the one-based columns whose serial-number cells become UTC instants.
